changed.what: 2019 -> 2018; status same and retrodiction false unchanged. Patient side (etokimab blood-eosinophil fall in AD) first public in May 2018 at EAACI, per AnaptysBio Q2 2018 release recounting the May 2018 EAACI presentation (https://ir.anaptysbio.com/news-releases/news-release-details/anaptysbio-announces-second-quarter-2018-financial-results-and): blood eosinophils down 40% at day 29 after one etokimab dose; model side 2013.

2019 -> 2018; status same and retrodiction false unchanged. Patient side first public May 2018 at EAACI, where the 40% eosinophil fall was explicitly aligned with IL33 loss-of-function genotypes, per AnaptysBio Q2 2018 release recounting the May 2018 EAACI presentation (https://ir.anaptysbio.com/news-releases/news-release-details/anaptysbio-announces-second-quarter-2018-financial-results-and): blood eosinophils down 40% at day 29 after one etokimab dose; model side (Smith 2017 PLoS Genet) 2017.

2024 -> 2016; status untested and retrodiction false unchanged. Itepekimab track opener moved from the 2024 patient paper to itepekimab's own first-use proxy, first-in-human NCT02958436 posted 2016-11-08 (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT02958436); the model system's 2021 first use is torudokimab's.
